name: Operational Land Imager (OLI)
explain: Calibrated pushbroom multispectral radiometer providing 30-meter resolution across 9 visible and near-infrared bands for land cover and wildfire tracking.
basis: NASA Landsat 8/9 OLI Specification, approximate, game-balanced

name: Thermal Infrared Sensor (TIRS)
explain: Quantum-well infrared photodetector imaging surface temperatures to measure evapotranspiration and drought stress. Requires cryogenic cooling down to 77K.
basis: NASA Landsat 8/9 TIRS Instrument Description, approximate, game-balanced

name: Sub-Meter Panchromatic Camera
explain: Long-focal-length folded Schmidt Cassegrain telescope capturing ultra-high-detail 0.5-meter imagery across a narrow ground swath.
basis: WorldView-3 / GeoEye-1 Optical Subsystem, approximate, game-balanced

name: X-Band Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR)
explain: All-weather active phased-array radar penetrating clouds, smoke, and nighttime to monitor surface deformation, soil moisture, and flooding.
basis: TerraSAR-X / Sentinel-1 C-SAR Technical Summary, approximate, game-balanced

name: Imaging Hyperspectral Spectrometer
explain: Captures 200+ continuous spectral bands to identify specific mineral compositions, canopy water content, and algal bloom biochemistry.
basis: NASA PRISMA / EnMAP Hyperspectral Payload, approximate, game-balanced

name: 4-Camera Wide-Field Transit Photometer
explain: Quad-camera refractive optical assembly providing a massive combined 24° x 96° field of view (2304 deg²) for continuous exoplanet transit monitoring.
basis: MIT / NASA TESS Instrument Description, approximate, game-balanced

name: High-Precision Stellar Spectrograph
explain: Fiber-fed echelle spectrograph measuring radial velocity stellar wobble and characterizing planetary upper atmospheric transmission spectra.
basis: Kepler / ESPRESSO Spaceborne Spectrograph Concept, approximate, game-balanced

name: High-Contrast Stellar Coronagraph
explain: Internal deformable mirror coronagraph capable of suppressing host star glare by a factor of 10^9 to directly image mature exoplanets.
basis: NASA Roman Space Telescope Coronagraph Instrument (CGI), approximate, game-balanced

name: Flash LIDAR & Hazard Detection Suite
explain: High-rate 3D pulsed laser imaging system providing real-time terrain-relative navigation, slope analysis, and boulder avoidance.
basis: NASA Autonomous Landing Hazard Avoidance Technology (ALHAT) / Chandrayaan-3 Hazard Detection and Avoidance Camera, approximate, game-balanced

name: Alpha Particle X-Ray Spectrometer & Drill
explain: Surface deployment package with a curium-244 radiation source and rock drill for elemental rock composition and water-ice volatile analysis.
basis: Mars Exploration Rover APXS / Chandrayaan-3 ChaSTE payload, approximate, game-balanced
